cases.name: Deepwater Horizon
cases.method: Seed 2000 particles uniformly inside the outline of day D (water points only), run 72 h from D 18:00 UTC on HYCOM-TSIS reanalysis currents + winds, compare with the outlines of D+1/D+2/D+3. Persistence = outline D unchanged.
